answer: A live cross-examination pool blocks bulk fakes: each identity must answer in real time. Each epoch it draws 5% at random, pairing each with two examiners who mirror the same questions from different angles, so replayed scripts fail. Missing its signal window or contradicting its history freezes it one epoch and burns 30 credits. The k-th fake still needs a k-th live human, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 responders at 10 credits each; an honest agent answers once. Each check closes with one ivory receipt, unusable for another identity.
